authorization: Owner chose ETH-only optimization after the proposed past-only netR calibration and selection study; research changes only, no live/paper preset changes.
fee_source: Unchanged OKX Lv1 account read2026-10-23; costs already reconciled in native ledger.
split: For test quarter Q, reuse model fitted before Q-1. The same frozen model scores Q-1 calibration and Q test. Calibration whole NY weeks must start in Q-1 and expire by Q start. No model refit after calibration. Incomplete current week scored only, excluded from evaluation.
selection_objective: Maximize calibration total netR after single-position admission; equivalent to mean total R per same calendar calibration week. Nonempty candidates need >=5 executed trades and >=3 traded NY weeks. Choose none when no eligible candidate has positive netR. Exact ties prefer candidate list order; threshold comparisons strictly >.
bias_rule: Add delta=sum(weekly mean(actual netR-raw score))/(calibration weeks+4). Fixed intercept-only shrinkage, no slope reversal or hyperparameter search; admit adjusted score>0.
single_variable: Fresh-to-lagged changes model cutoff only; calibration policies versus lagged_raw_zero change only the mapping of frozen score to admission. No feature, model, barrier, fill, fee, expiry or target routing changes.
engine: VectorBT broadcasts admission rules using compressed submission and cached native fill events. Slots reserve on submission; entry and exit at original Nautilus prices with original fee type. Fixed one dollar initial risk per independent trade; no OHLC replay or new native order calculation.
statistics: Weekly bootstrap2000/signflip10000; compare same test coverage. Primary near candidate prespecified. Holm across6 policy-target matched-control tests; report original and corrected p, baseline difference, years/sides/concentration,within-fold rank diagnostics. No test-selected target or policy promotion.
historical_use: These historical outcomes and prior top-decile diagnostics have already been inspected. Exploratory temporal evaluation, not untouched confirmation.
